name: OVO-Bench
description: OVO-Bench is a video benchmark focusing on temporal awareness for online video understanding by video LLMs. It evaluates reasoning and response capabilities at specific timestamps under backward tracing, real-time understanding, and forward active responding scenarios.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for online video understanding that is emerging in the video-LLM community but is not yet a standard leader-board benchmark.
notes: Includes 644 unique videos and ~2800 human-curated fine-grained meta-annotations with timestamps; combines automated generation and human curation.
